Tenor saxophonist Eric Alexander has recorded prolifically since his debut in 1991. He is a graduate of the jazz program at William Paterson University and he cites George Coleman and Harold Mabern as important influences on his approach to jazz improvising.
Eric was interviewed at Hamilton College on March 31, 2010, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are interviewing for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College, on campus, with Eric Alexander. Welcome.
